meta.title: Tastr
meta.description: Discover your movie taste from your Trakt, Letterboxd, or Bingers data.

title: Your movie profile,
read from your data.
home.lead: Upload your watch history export and discover the directors, genres, and actors you truly love — computed entirely from data you already own.

steps.title: Export your data
steps.body: Download the .zip with your movie and show history from Trakt, Letterboxd, or Bingers.

steps.title: Upload the archive
steps.body: Drop the zip on the upload page: the system automatically recognizes the source service.

steps.title: Explore your taste
steps.body: We analyze the data with TMDB and generate dashboards on your favorite directors, genres, and viewing habits.

topPeople.title: top 10 directors and actors
topPeople.incompleteBody: {count} movies don't have TMDB credits yet.

topPeople.errorGeneric: Analysis failed. Check your connection and try again.
topPeople.empty: No movies with credits available: finish the analysis to build the ranking.
topPeople.legend: score = log₂(1 + exposure) × quality. Exposure counts distinct movies — weighted by billing position for actors — and grows {rewatch}% per rewatch. Quality is how far your ratings sit from your {mean} average, damped by adding {k} phantom ratings at the average: that way a single very high rating on one movie weighs less than many above-average ratings across many movies.

rating.title: how you rate
rating.prompt: Old movies or new ones — which get your higher scores?

watching.title: what you watch
watching.prompt: Do you queue up new releases, or the back catalogue?

focus.title: how deep you dig
focus.prompt: Do you go down a rabbit hole, or sample everything once?

crowd.title: you and the crowd
crowd.prompt: Do your ratings track what everyone else thinks?

genres.title: your two genres
genres.prompt: The pair you watched most, and the animal it makes.

reviewer.title: reviewer or lurker
reviewer.prompt: How much of what you watch do you actually rate?

rhythm.title: your rhythm
rhythm.prompt: Spread across the year, or all in a few weeks?

rewatch.title: again, or never again
rewatch.prompt: How much of your year was spent on movies you already knew?

nostalgic.name: Nostalgic
nostalgic.body: The older the movie, the higher you score it. Your best ratings live in the back catalogue.

modern.name: Modern
modern.body: Recent releases get your best scores. What just came out is what convinces you.

gourmet.name: Gourmet
gourmet.body: Your ratings don't care what year it is. Old or new, you score on the movie in front of you.

current.name: Current
current.body: Most of what you watched is fresh out. You keep up with what is on right now.

archivist.name: Archivist
archivist.body: You spend your year in the catalogue. Most of what you watched is older than a decade.

omnivore.name: Omnivore
omnivore.body: New releases and old ones, in comparable doses. Release year is not how you pick.

specialist.name: Specialist
specialist.body: You go down rabbit holes: a few genres, directors you come back to, whole filmographies.

curator.name: Curator
curator.body: You have favourites and you feed them, but you keep enough room for what you have never tried.

wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.body: You almost never watch the same thing twice in a row. Every movie comes from somewhere else.

conformist.name: Conformist
conformist.body: What the crowd calls good, you call good too. Your ranking and TMDB's move together.

independent.name: Independent
independent.body: You overlap with the crowd, then part ways often enough to keep it interesting.

contrarian.name: Contrarian
contrarian.body: Public consensus tells us almost nothing about your ratings. You score for yourself.

reviewer.name: Reviewer
reviewer.body: Almost nothing gets past you unrated. Watching and judging are the same act.

selective.name: Selective
selective.body: You rate when a movie earns an opinion, and let the rest go by unmarked.

lurker.name: Lurker
lurker.body: You watch a lot and say little. Most of your year left no rating behind.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.body: Movies almost every month, in steady doses. Your year has no empty stretches.

tidal.name: Tidal
tidal.body: You come and go in waves: busy stretches, then quiet ones, then back again.

marathoner.name: Marathoner
marathoner.body: Your year is concentrated in bursts. When you watch, you watch a lot at once.

ritualist.name: Ritualist
ritualist.body: A large share of your year went to movies you already knew by heart. Rewatching is the point.

loyalist.name: Loyalist
loyalist.body: You mostly move forward, but you keep going back to a handful of favourites.

pioneer.name: Pioneer
pioneer.body: Almost every viewing was a first time. You would rather risk a new one than replay a sure thing.

hawk.name: Hawk
hawk.body: Two genres, one gear: full speed. You watch movies that move, and you watch them for the chase.

panther.name: Panther
panther.body: Fast and unlit. You like the hunt better when nobody on screen can be trusted.

mustang.name: Mustang
mustang.body: You want the ride, but you want someone worth caring about while it happens.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.body: Nothing you watch obeys physics, and none of it has time to explain itself.

monkey.name: Monkey
monkey.body: Chaos, but funny. Your movies run fast and land on a punchline.

eagle.name: Eagle
eagle.body: You watch what really happened, told at altitude and at speed.

raven.name: Raven
raven.body: You spend your movie hours where the lights are off and the motive is unclear.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.body: You look for the wound under the crime. Nobody in your movies gets out clean.

bat.name: Bat
bat.body: You take your nightmares invented. The stranger the world, the darker you like it.

fox.name: Fox
fox.body: You laugh in the wrong places, on purpose. Comedy and crime are the same trick to you.

owl.name: Owl
owl.body: You watch what happened, then what it hid. Patient, and always a little suspicious.

swan.name: Swan
swan.body: Feelings at full volume, with a score underneath. You are here for the ache.

deer.name: Deer
deer.body: You want to be moved somewhere that doesn't exist: tenderness, with the world redrawn.

otter.name: Otter
otter.body: You watch movies that like people. Warm, quick, and easy to put on again.

elephant.name: Elephant
elephant.body: You keep what happened and what it cost. Long memory, heavy heart.

octopus.name: Octopus
octopus.body: Everything you watch was invented from scratch, and the stranger it gets the better.

dolphin.name: Dolphin
dolphin.body: Imagination with a grin. You like your other worlds friendly.

chameleon.name: Chameleon
chameleon.body: Half documented, half impossible. You keep changing which half you believe.

meerkat.name: Meerkat
meerkat.body: You watch to feel better, preferably with company, and you are not sorry about it.

raccoon.name: Raccoon
raccoon.body: You go through real life looking for the funny part, and you usually find it.

tortoise.name: Tortoise
tortoise.body: You watch what actually happened, slowly, and you remember all of it.

keeper.name: The Keeper
keeper.body: You dig deep into a few corners, and what you find there the world already calls good. You are building a canon, not arguing with one.

scholar.name: The Scholar
scholar.body: You follow genres and directors all the way down, and you come out with your own opinion of them.

cultist.name: The Cultist
cultist.body: You go deep and you come back with verdicts nobody shares. Your favourites are yours alone.

classicist.name: The Classicist
classicist.body: You keep a broad diet and land close to consensus: a reliable recommendation, and rarely a surprising one.

cinephile.name: The Cinephile
cinephile.body: Wide range, your own scoreboard. You have seen enough to disagree on purpose.

heretic.name: The Heretic
heretic.body: You watch a bit of everything and rate almost none of it the way the crowd does.

explorer.name: The Explorer
explorer.body: You are always somewhere new, and you tend to like what everyone else liked when you get there.

nomad.name: The Nomad
nomad.body: You never stay in one genre long, and you judge every stop for yourself.

maverick.name: The Maverick
maverick.body: No territory, no consensus. Your year is impossible to predict from anyone else's ratings.

newcomer.name: The Newcomer
newcomer.body: This year doesn't have enough movies to pin down a profile yet. Watch more, rate more, come back.
